an6.26:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tatra kho āyasmā mahākaccāno bhikkhu āmantesi,
an6.26:1.3: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahā kaccānassa paccassosuṃ.
an6.26:1.7: yāva subhāsitaṃ cidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya. nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cha anussatiṭṭhānāni
an6.26:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā [arahaṃ] …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti,
an6.26:2.4: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.26:2.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā
an6.26:2.7: sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati, vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an6.26:2.8: idampi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. (2)
an6.26:3.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati:
an6.26:3.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.26:3.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
an6.26:3.6: sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an6.26:3.7: idampi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. (3)
an6.26:4.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati.
an6.26:4.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
an6.26:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
an6.26:4.6: sa kho so āvuso ariya sāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an6.26:4.7: idampi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. (4)
an6.26:5.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni …pe… samādhi saṃvattanikāni.
an6.26:5.2: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako attano sīlaṃ anussarati. nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
an6.26:5.3: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
an6.26:5.5: sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso akāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an6.26:5.6: idampi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. (5)
an6.26:6.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati:
an6.26:6.4: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti. na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
an6.26:6.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti. nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
an6.26:6.7: sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an6.26:6.8: idampi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. (6)
an6.26:7.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso ariyasāvako devatā anussarati:
an6.26:7.3: yathā rūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā, mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.
an6.26:7.7: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatīti.
an6.26:7.8: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosa pariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
an6.26:7.9: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti. nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
an6.26:7.11: sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an6.26:7.12: idampi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti
an6.26:8.2: yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ imāni cha anussati
